title: weekly-sync-serving-runtime-infra-console-agenda-2026-03-09-prep
content:
Weekly sync (serving-runtime / infra / console) - Meeting prep - 2026-03-09
Owner: Aisha Patel
Time: 30m sync (Tue 09:30 PT)
Location: #eng-serving-runtime (Zoom link in calendar)
Attendees (TBD): Aisha, Liam, Priya, Marco, Joon, rotating SRE rep

Purpose: quick alignment on rollouts, infra capacity, perf regressions, console telemetry, and outstanding action items. Keep it tight; call out blockers early.

AGENDA (30m)
1) Quick round (3m)
   - One-sentence status each: green/yellow/red + blocker

2) Incidents / regressions (6m)
   - SRV-412: tokenization edge-case causing OOMs on long-prefix requests (Priya)
   - Current: hotfix deployed to canary, investigating root cause in tokenizer shard code
   - Ask: SRE to run targeted load tests on canary before broader rollout
   - INFRA-233: autoscaler thrash on bursty embedding workloads (Marco)
   - Metrics: p95 scale-up latency ~28s under test; want <15s

3) Rollouts / model variants (6m)
   - Canary for opt-13b-v2 on dedicated cluster A (Liam)
   - Current traffic: 2% - observed 7% latency increase for seq len >1024
   - Action: revert if regression persists after kernel patch
   - Quantization profile updates (Aisha)
   - Plan: run batch of 10k eval prompts next week; need compute reservation

4) Console / observability items (6m)
   - New token-level cost breakdown POC (Joon)
   - Need validation from billing team on mapping rules
   - Tracing hooks for KV cache misses (Priya)
   - PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/observability/pull/122 (in review)

5) Capacity & ops (4m)
   - GPU capacity forecast for March -> April (Marco)
   - Shortfall of ~12 A100 equivalents if growth + upcoming canaries proceed
   - Ask: infra to model burst option (spot vs reserved) and cost delta

6) Action items review & next steps (3m)
   - Rapid review of open action items from last week and owners/due dates

ACTION ITEMS (track here)
- [ ] Priya: finish tokenizer debug and post root-cause summary in SRV-412 by 2026-03-10
- [ ] SRE (assign): run targeted canary load test against tokenizer hotfix by 2026-03-11
- [ ] Liam: monitor canary for opt-13b-v2, collect latency histograms, and report by 2026-03-10
- [ ] Marco: run autoscaler repro in staging, gather scale-up latency traces, assign INFRA-233 owner by 2026-03-12
- [ ] Aisha: reserve 48 GPU-hours for quantization evals and share schedule by 2026-03-11
- [ ] Joon: finalize token-level cost POC and sync with billing on mapping rules by 2026-03-13
- [ ] Priya: open follow-up PR for tracing hooks if review passes; otherwise address comments by 2026-03-09

PARKING LOT / DISCUSS OFFLINE
- Long-term: automatic model variant fallback policy tuning (need perf budget proposal)
- Investigate cheaper burst capacity options (partner with finance)

NOTES / CONTEXT (quick links)
- SRV-412 thread: JIRA SRV-412
- INFRA-233 autoscaler notes: JIRA INFRA-233
- Opt-13b-v2 kernel patch: GH PR 879 (serving-runtime)
- Observability tracing PR: GH PR 122

PREP REQUESTS (for attendees)
- Bring 1 key metric or blocker to share in the 1-sentence round
- Owners: post brief update to the linked JIRA before the meeting if possible

NEXT MEETING
- Tue 2026-03-16 09:30 PT

---
Notes to self (Aisha):
- Follow up with Finance on burst cost model before Friday; add to next 1:1 with Marco.
- If tokenization root cause is complicated, schedule a deep-dive session with tokenizer author and SREs next week.
